title: Real 0DTE skew is regime-dependent; model re-centred
detail: Implied vols backed out of real SPXW 0DTE trades at 10:00 ET (Robinhood 5m bars, 11/13 and 11/18). Put skew: 0.24-0.31 per 1% OTM on a calm day (ATM IV 10.9%), 0.10-0.12 on a stressed day (ATM IV 15.3%). Calls: flat (about 0, not -0.05). The H1 sweep moved from 0.15/0.25/0.35 to 0.10/0.20/0.30 and call skew to 0 before any run. Caveat: last-trade prices, two days only.
